title: Your Metabolism Is Not The Reason You're Fat
hook: Your age is not the reason you're gaining weight. So what changed since you were 25? You have more stress. You're eating worse food without realizing it. You move less and you sleep worse.
body:
Food first. Decide what you eat before you're hungry, and then eat the protein first. If it's fast food, order for protein.

Then do 15 minutes of exercise first thing every morning. It gets you moving again and takes the edge off the stress.
close: It's not your age, which means you can fix it. Subscribe to my channel and go to SixPackAbs.com for all my newest videos.
